notes: Left join preserves all abundance sample IDs and order. Visit metadata is populated only on exact SampleID=VisitID matches.
For unmatched visits, subject-level metadata is joined using the SampleID prefix, explicitly marked as a candidate relationship. No suffixes are stripped to guess visit matches.
Subject age, BMI and SSPG are subject-level portal values, not verified visit-specific measurements.
CollectionDate contains numeric source values; date origin and unit are not established. Preserve without conversion.
NA, Unknown and empty strings retained from source.
Repeated samples from the same participant are not independent.
Source event labels and notes are retained verbatim and require harmonization before analysis.
